reviews.text: I am very happy with Bahia's progress, and especially with my own, in understanding and training my dog. Eryn is very competent and I recommend that everyone seek her guidance to better understand how to train their puppy.
Eryn is very gentle and patient with both owners and dogs, and the various training sessions have proven very effective. We will, in fact, continue with her beyond these initial stages.

City dog ​​walk, amazing!

Thank you so much, it was fantastic and I highly recommend it! 😍

I started Hooper training with Eryn about a year ago. Tuco's progress is steady; we learn a little more with each lesson. Eryn is methodical, encouraging, attentive, gentle, and has excellent interpersonal skills. Lessons with her are always a great time for both dog and owner! We learn while having fun, without any pressure.

Eryn has been helping us with Hoopers for almost a year now, always ensuring Vicky's success and adapting to her individual needs. She's one of the few truly trained professionals in the 13th arrondissement to teach this sport!
I highly recommend her to anyone wanting to have fun and share a great activity with their dog.

We were fortunate to have Eryn work with our little cocker spaniel, Dea, especially during her adolescence, a time when she sometimes struggled to manage her emotions and wasn't always very comfortable around people or certain dog mixes.

We chose the 5-session package to better understand Dea and learn how to support her daily. Eryn was a great help, particularly with the mixes and in channeling her urge to jump into every body of water in Aix-en-Provence 😅

The sessions take place in different locations, with varied stimulation: in town, in the park, and sometimes accompanied by her dog, Aki. This makes each session very interesting and allows us to work in situations similar to everyday life.

Eryn is also very available to answer our questions between sessions. Dea's progress is already truly visible: she is gaining more confidence, and we now have better tools to continue moving forward.

A huge thank you to Eryn for her kindness, her attentiveness, her patience, and her gentleness with Dea. 🐶❤️

Another fantastic experience with Eryn! This time for our city-loving dog. Eryn perfectly adapted the route for our city-phobic pup, who thoroughly enjoyed this outing in Aix-en-Provence!
Thanks again!
Eryn is a great listener and very kind, I highly recommend her 👌⭐️✨ …

We hired Eryn to visit our dogs at home once a week while we're away, to break up their day. Besides the fact that our dogs adore her (thanks in part to her gentle and reassuring approach with our sensitive female dog), I particularly appreciate Eryn's professionalism, reliability, punctuality, and the detailed reports she provides after each visit, whether it's to report a minor limp, a change in behavior, or simply to describe the games she plays with them. Thanks to Eryn, our dogs cope very well with their day alone, and we trust her completely!

I entrusted the care of my cat Chachou to Eryn during my week-long absence, and everything went perfectly.

Eryn is a kind, caring, attentive, and passionate person. She took the time to conduct a preliminary visit to fully understand Chachou's needs and get to know him, and she provided me with updates after each visit, including photos and videos. I felt completely reassured and was able to enjoy my trip with peace of mind.

I highly recommend her.

I hired Eryn as a pet sitter while I was on vacation. She got along wonderfully with my cat and really took the time to play and cuddle him. I received daily updates with lots of photos and videos. I highly recommend her!
Eryn is very helpful, pleasant, and great with animals!!!

We opted for a puppy training package for our little Anubis... she's a lively Border Collie and our first dog. The sessions allowed us to approach Anubis's training with more calm and serenity. We learned to deal with difficulties calmly and kindly.

Eryn is a fantastic pet sitter! 👌 She's so kind, gentle, and attentive to our little four-legged friends.

I highly recommend her.
My little Ari adores her! 🫶🏻

We adopted our first dog in 2023. We were worried about doing things wrong with Uma, so we contacted Eryn, who was incredibly helpful and kind.

We subsequently contacted her several times to have Uma looked after, including for three weeks in August.

Uma is a very anxious dog, and it's difficult for her to be away from us. Eryn handled this perfectly and ensured Uma had a wonderful summer.

We wholeheartedly recommend Eryn and will continue to use her services for our dog, who now adores her!

A huge thank you again to Eryn for everything she did for our sweet little furball.

Eryn is a very professional person.

Patient and attentive to our needs.

She took care of our cat while we were on vacation. She is very meticulous.

I recommend her without hesitation!

Thank you again for everything :)

I'm very satisfied!

Everything went perfectly: the walks were done carefully, and my dogs were happy and relaxed when I got back. I highly recommend them!
Eryn is fantastic! Very attentive, kind, and full of helpful suggestions to address our issues. I especially enjoyed learning about hoppers with her. River loved it :) I highly recommend her!
